9.3: tāṃ stanyakāma āsādya mathnantīṃ jananīṃ hariḥ | gṛhītvā dadhimanthānaṃ nyaṣedhatprītimāvahan

13.1: satāmayaṃ sārabhṛtāṃ nisargo yadarthavāṇīśruticetasāmapi | pratikṣaṇaṃ navyavadacyutasya yat striyā viṭānāmiva sādhuvārtā
13.5: atra bhoktavyamasmābhirdivā rūḍhaṃ kṣudhārditāḥ | vatsāḥ samīpe'paḥ pītvā carantu śanakaistṛṇam
13.6: tatheti pāyayitvārbhā vatsānārudhya śādvale | muktvā śikyāni bubhujuḥ samaṃ bhagavatā mudā
13.7: kṛṣṇasya viṣvakpururājimaṇḍalairabhyānanāḥ phulladṛśo vrajārbhakāḥ | sahopaviṣṭā vipine virejuśchadā yathāmbhoruhakarṇikāyāḥ
13.8: kecitpuṣpairdalaiḥ kecitpallavairaṅkuraiḥ phalaiḥ | śigbhistvagbhirdṛṣadbhiśca bubhujuḥ kṛtabhājanāḥ
13.9: sarve mitho darśayantaḥ svasvabhojyaruciṃ pṛthak | hasanto hāsayantaścābhyavajahruḥ saheśvarāḥ

15.3: sa tatra tatrāruṇapallavaśriyā phalaprasūnorubhareṇa pādayoḥ | spṛśacchikhān vīkṣya vanaspatīn mudā smayannivāhāgrajamādipūruṣaḥ
15.4: śrībhagavānuvāca | aho amī deva varāmarārcitaṃ pādāmbujaṃ te sumanaḥphalārhaṇam | namantyupādāya śikhābhirātmanastamo'pahatyai tarujanma yatkṛtam
15.5: ete'linastava yaśo'khilalokatīrthaṃ gāyanta ādipuruṣānupadaṃ bhajante | prāyo amī munigaṇā bhavadīyamukhyā gūḍhaṃ vane'pi na jahatyanaghātmadaivam
15.6: nṛtyantyamī śikhina īḍya mudā hariṇyaḥ kurvanti gopya iva te priyamīkṣaṇena | sūktaiśca kokilagaṇā gṛhamāgatāya dhanyā vanaukasa iyān hi satāṃ nisargaḥ
15.7: dhanyeyamadya dharaṇī tṛṇavīrudhastvatpādaspṛśo drumalatāḥ karajābhimṛṣṭāḥ | nadyo'drayaḥ khagamṛgāḥ sadayāvalokairgopyo'ntareṇa bhujayorapi yatspṛhā śrīḥ
15.8: śrīśuka uvāca | evaṃ vṛndāvanaṃ śrīmatkṛṣṇaḥ prītamanāḥ paśūn | reme sañcārayannadreḥ saridrodhaḥsu sānugaḥ
15.9: kvacidgāyati gāyatsu madāndhāliṣvanuvrataiḥ | upagīyamānacaritaḥ sragvī saṅkarṣaṇānvitaḥ
15.10: (anujalpati jalpantaṃ kalavākyaiḥ śukaṃ kvacit | kvacitsa valgu kūjantamanukūjati kokilam ||) kvacicca kalahaṃsānāmanukūjati kūjitam | abhinṛtyati nṛtyantaṃ barhiṇaṃ hāsayan kvacit
15.11: meghagambhīrayā vācā nāmabhirdūragān paśūn | kvacidāhvayati prītyā gogopālamanojñayā
15.12: cakorakrauñcacakrāhvabhāradvājāṃśca barhiṇaḥ | anurauti sma sattvānāṃ bhītavadvyāghrasiṃhayoḥ
15.14: nṛtyato gāyataḥ kvāpi valgato yudhyato mithaḥ | gṛhītahastau gopālān hasantau praśaśaṃsatuḥ
15.16: pādasaṃvāhanaṃ cakruḥ kecittasya mahātmanaḥ | apare hatapāpmāno vyajanaiḥ samavījayan
15.17: anye tadanurūpāṇi manojñāni mahātmanaḥ | gāyanti sma mahārāja snehaklinnadhiyaḥ śanaiḥ
15.42: pītvā mukundamukhasāraghamakṣibhṛṅgaistāpaṃ jahurvirahajaṃ vrajayoṣito'hni | tatsatkṛtiṃ samadhigamya viveśa goṣṭhaṃ savrīḍahāsavinayaṃ yadapāṅgamokṣam

18.7: krīḍiṣyamāṇastatkṛṣṇo bhagavān balasaṃyutaḥ | veṇuṃ viraṇayan gopairgodhanaiḥ saṃvṛto'viśat
18.19: tatra cakruḥ parivṛḍhau gopā rāmajanārdanau | kṛṣṇasaṅghaṭṭinaḥ kecidāsan rāmasya cāpare
18.20: ācerurvividhāḥ krīḍā vāhyavāhakalakṣaṇāḥ | yatrārohanti jetāro vahanti ca parājitāḥ
18.21: vahanto vāhyamānāśca cārayantaśca godhanam | bhāṇḍīrakaṃ nāma vaṭaṃ jagmuḥ kṛṣṇapurogamāḥ
18.22: rāmasaṅghaṭṭino yarhi śrīdāmavṛṣabhādayaḥ | krīḍāyāṃ jayinastāṃstānūhuḥ kṛṣṇādayo nṛpa
18.23: uvāha kṛṣṇo bhagavān śrīdāmānaṃ parājitaḥ | vṛṣabhaṃ bhadrasenastu pralambo rohiṇīsutam
18.24: aviṣahyaṃ manyamānaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ dānavapuṅgavaḥ | vahandrutataraṃ prāgādavarohaṇataḥ param

29.43: upagīyamāna udgāyan vanitāśatayūthapaḥ | mālāṃ bibhradvaijayantīṃ vyacaranmaṇḍayan vanam
29.46: evaṃ bhagavataḥ kṛṣṇāllabdhamānā mahātmanaḥ | ātmānaṃ menire strīṇāṃ māninyo'bhyadhikaṃ bhuvi

33.2: rāsotsavaḥ sampravṛtto gopīmaṇḍalamaṇḍitaḥ | yogeśvareṇa kṛṣṇena tāsāṃ madhye dvayordvayoḥ | praviṣṭena gṛhītānāṃ kaṇṭhe svanikaṭaṃ striyaḥ
33.6: tatrātiśuśubhe tābhirbhagavān devakīsutaḥ | madhye maṇīnāṃ haimānāṃ mahāmarakato yathā
33.7: pādanyāsairbhujavidhutibhiḥ sasmitairbhrūvilāsaiḥ bhajyan madhyaiścalakucapaṭaiḥ kuṇḍalairgaṇḍalolaiḥ | svidyan mukhyaḥ kabararaśanāgranthayaḥ kṛṣṇavadhvo gāyantyastaṃ taḍita iva tā meghacakre virejuḥ
33.9: kācitsamaṃ mukundena svarajātīramiśritāḥ | unninye pūjitā tena prīyatā sādhu sādhviti | tadeva dhruvamunninye tasyai mānaṃ ca bahvadāt
33.10: kācidrāsapariśrāntā pārśvasthasya gadābhṛtaḥ | jagrāha bāhunā skandhaṃ ślathadvalayamallikā

35.1: gopya ūcuḥ | vāmabāhukṛtavāmakapolo valgitabhruradharārpitaveṇum | komalāṅgulibhirāśritamārgaṃ gopya īrayati yatra mukundaḥ
